<function name="GetViewMatrix" parent="cam" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns a copy of the view matrix. Also see <page>cam.GetProjectionMatrix</page>.

Will return Identity matrix in 2D Render context. In this case use <page>cam.Start3D</page>. See <page text="Render Hook Order">Render_Order</page>.
	</description>
	<added>2026.06.03</added>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="VMatrix">The currently active view matrix.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
